title: Music box
summary: pick a tune, turn the crank
description: A printable cylinder music box: a pinned drum for three old tunes, a comb whose teeth are tuned by the cantilever formula, cut from spring steel or printed, and a crank that plays the tune while the pins pass the comb.
process: 3D printing (FDM); spring-steel comb laser cut, or printed comb

difficulty.rationale: Data-driven wrapped pins, tuned comb, closed-form pluck and many coupled cross-body formulas over a wide range.

standards: Cantilever beam first bending mode, Euler-Bernoulli: omega_1 = 3.5160 / L^2 * sqrt(EI / mu)
Laser cut slot at least the sheet thickness
materials: Printed in PETG or PLA: case, drum with pins and gear, pinion, crank arm, comb clamp, pawl
Comb: spring-steel strip 0.3 or 0.5 mm, hardened, laser cut; or printed PETG or PLA, 1.6 mm
Steel rod, 4 mm: drum axle, crank shaft and pawl pin
Three M3 x 12 screws into the comb's pedestal
